data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 17.113m in 2020, primarily driven by favorable claims development on the 2018 year of account. This contrasts with the net favorable development of GBP 6.6m mentioned in the notes. The 2018 year of account closed at an ultimate loss of GBP 6.1m. The current year (2020) was impacted by higher than expected claims activity, including major losses from Hurricane Sally on Property lines and additional reserves for COVID-19 losses. The 2019 result included exposure to Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis.
